title: Stage IV Melanoma Thriver
content: Stage IV Melanoma ThriverRadical Remission ProjectSep 6, 20241 min readDuring a routine medical appointment, William’s doctor wanted to follow up with a CT scan due to concerns with his blood results. The CT showed something concerning in his lower right lung and a biopsy confirmed it was stage IV metastatic melanoma. William did surgery to remove the cancer and then began immunotherapy, but ultimately had to stop due to an autoimmune reaction.At this point his oncologist gave him a prognosis of 8-10 months to live. So, William took matters into his own hands. He researched alternative treatments and found two that were natural and affordable. After six months of following these natural options and implementing the Radical Remission healing factors, his CT scans were clear and have remained so ever since.He is fulfilling his lifelong dream of writing and sharing his experiences and knowledge through the written word.
